entities.name: Pyrroloquinoline-quinone synthase
observations: The 247-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt B9JJ30 from Rhizobium rhizogenes.
Assigned EC number is EC 1.3.3.11; GO molecular function is pyrroloquinoline-quinone synthase activity.

entities.name: PQQ biosynthesis oxidation
observations: Pyrroloquinoline-quinone synthase catalyzes ring cyclization and eight-electron oxidation of 3a-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-4,5-dioxo-4,5,6,7,8,9-hexahydroquinoline-7,9-dicarboxylic acid to pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ).
Rhea reaction RHEA:10692 is represented as: 6-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-7,8-dioxo-1,2,3,4,7,8-hexahydroquinoline-2,4-dicarboxylate + 3 O2 = PQQ + 2 H2O2 + 2 H2O + H(+).
The reaction belongs to pyrroloquinoline quinone cofactor biosynthesis.

entities.name: PQQ biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme is annotated in the pyrroloquinoline quinone biosynthetic process, GO:0018189.
